subject: Re: Kickoff: Betum Tool for the Artemis Workshop (Dakar, June 1-5)
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and hosting:

- Farah 60% (toolkit core + COCOEval harness), Chiara 50% (model profiles - she has OWL-ViT and YOLO26 running already), Tereza 30% (SAM 3 box-conversion path and the generative track).
- Compute for the workshop itself: 16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort is plenty; students run inference and light fine-tuning, not pretraining.
- Data hosting: I talked to Jun's team about where the dataset lives during the migration window. Jun confirmed the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10, comfortably after the workshop, so we'll host the Coffee & Cashew dataset on legacy Corpus for June and migrate in the first week of July. That avoids making the students guinea pigs for v2 ingestion.
- One budget item: ~$4k for offline mirrors (portable drives) as a connectivity fallback in Dakar. Approving from my line unless you object.

Bao
